literature_basis.title: Segregation in Granular Flow Under Lunar Conditions
literature_basis.role: Defines the proposed Bo_m, I and signed electrostatic-number regime coordinates; apparatus-specific applicability still requires validation.

common_rules.missing_primitives: derived coordinate status must be unknown; never substitute zero
common_rules.units: convert all inputs to SI before evaluation
common_rules.uncertainty: propagate primitive uncertainty; first-order GUM when linearization is defensible, otherwise Monte Carlo or interval bounds
common_rules.correlation: include known covariance between measurements; do not assume independence without documenting the assumption
common_rules.derived_provenance: store exact formula_set_id, derivation_method_id, calculation_version and source artifact IDs
common_rules.claim_ceiling: dimensionless similarity is a screening comparison, not proof of dynamic similarity, constitutive equivalence or lunar hardware qualification
